name: Shield Shelf
mix: Yellow belt and up. A Bopper's long reach behind a Shield Guard: Strike the shield, punish the Bopper's recovery.
legend: # = wall, . = floor, P = player start, D = door slot (in the outer wall), C = chest, S = rest shrine
waves_note: Enemies arrive in waves: the next wave comes when 1 enemy (or none) is left.
artProps: Layout copied from staff-and-shield. Theme and props from the giants-steps draft room "shield-shelf". One long stone shelf across the room with a wide gap in the middle, like a cupboard for giants; round shield-shaped stones lean on the wall.
signs: Look up, look down, look around.
